title: Settings
storm: Include solar storm replay ({date}) in the margin
stormOn: On: your route's four-term margin includes the dose term, with the storm at your route's worst moment; the official plan's numbers stay as published.
stormOff: Off: your route's margin drops the dose term; the official plan's numbers stay as published.

start.title: EVA start
start.seasonTitle: Areocentric solar longitude (season) and Mars year
start.daylightTitle: Minutes from EVA start until the sun sets on a flat horizon: the margin's daylight term
start.sunDownNotice: The sun is below the horizon at this start: the daylight margin is negative from the first minute.
start.isDefault: Default: {lmst} LMST on the sol of {date} (clock.json).
start.changed: Changed from the default {lmst} LMST, sol of {date}.
start.custom: custom start · outside the validated scenario

boundary.title: Reachable-area boundary
boundary.caption: The area from which the crew can walk back to the pad within that time.
